name: Valik
summary: In a Syndicate camp, Valik lies dying with an enemy before them. Valik expects you to kill them, but offers answers for a mug of Southshore Stout.

sections.title: A Dying Bargain
sections.body: Henchman Valik lies wounded in the Syndicate camp, with you standing before them as an enemy. They expect you to kill them all the same. Yet Valik offers answers to your questions if you bring a mug of Southshore Stout to the camp. They even wonder aloud whether your kind drinks at all.

sections.title: Valik's Last Drink
sections.body: Valik calls the stout the sweetest thing they have ever tasted, though death waits. They hand you something of no use to the dead. Then Valik tells you to get on with it.

faq.answer: Henchman Valik lies injured and dying in the Syndicate camp.
Valik wants you to bring a mug of Southshore Stout to the Syndicate camp.

faq.q: What does Valik promise in return for the stout?
faq.answer: Valik promises to share what you seek, though they expect you to kill them afterward.
